name: library-semantics-false-positive
query: /localreview (on a branch whose diff relies on an auth plugin option, e.g. authenticatedUsersOnly, to keep anonymous sessions out of checkout)
expected_behavior: Banner states the scope (base ref, or all files when there is no common history)
A 'guests can reach checkout' claim is only verified if a voter quotes the installed library source (node_modules/<pkg>/dist) showing no anonymous-session guard; otherwise it is refuted
Headline has every normal and at most 8 nits; findings.json objects have exactly the 6 cloud keys

name: argument-parsing
expected_behavior: Treats 123 as PR mode and 'check the billing path' as the note, shown as Note (not a base)
Never aborts on unknown words; --fix applies after presenting and never commits

name: empty-diff
query: /localreview (on a clean main with no local changes)
expected_behavior: Stops in Phase 0 with: Nothing to review against main. Pass a base commit (/localreview <sha>) or a PR number.
